title: Trajectory Recovery of Visual Odometry at Corners by Temporal Stereo Point Cloud Registration
authors: Eshima Y.; Saito K.; Nakagawa M.
key_contribution: Proposes temporal stereo point-cloud registration to correct visual-odometry pose errors during sudden camera rotations; stage-1 screening is borderline-exclude under v2 because the abstract does not establish a qualifying degraded environment or quantitative metric.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Visual_LiDAR_Inertial_Fusion to ensure precise positioning.
